text:
I know writing a letter is old school. The texts are much more convenient, let's be real.
But I think there's something beautiful about the slowness.
A letter takes time. It's a big effort. So it really shows that you care.
There's something to be said for the handwriting. It's not perfect. It's not neat. But you can see the effort of the person. It's very human. It's very personal.
And I think that's beautiful. We get an email, we read it, we throw it away. We forget. But a letter stays in your room or your house. You look back years later and you open it and it's so special. And it really is.
So I love it.
I'm a big fan. And I think that's what it's all about.
And I think in the digital age, we need that. We need the slow down.
And a letter is a way to say, you're worth my time.
